stimuli.textContent: Good morning. The customer service desk on the first floor will close at 5:30 this afternoon for a staff meeting. If you need to return an item, please visit the desk before 5:00 or use our online form. Regular hours will resume tomorrow at 9:00 a.m.

tasks.instructionsVi: Trình bày ý kiến của bạn và đưa ra lý do hoặc ví dụ để hỗ trợ.

stimuli.textContent: Some companies allow employees to work from home several days a week. Do you think this is a good policy? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.

productRules: M05 captures and persists real audio responses.
M05 does not auto-generate a Speaking score.
A missing or failed recording is never converted into a numeric score.
Learner-facing status remains Chờ đánh giá until a genuine evaluator exists.
